title: Why Faye's last wish led Kratos to Jötunheim in God of War
subject: faye
description:
When did you realize Faye planned the whole journey? 👇

The marked trees, the wrong mountain and the murals in Jötunheim that Faye's family left behind. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The golden handprints on those trees belonged to Faye.
God of War opens with Kratos cutting them down for her funeral pyre.
Her wish was simple: scatter her ashes from the highest peak in all the realms.
Kratos and Atreus climbed Midgard's tallest mountain. Mimir said it was the wrong peak.
The real one stood in Jötunheim, land of the giants, its walls already painted.
The murals showed their whole journey. One panel named her Laufey. Another named their son Loki.
Faye had seen the path long before Kratos took his first step on it.
